bootstrap.note: 95% percentile bootstrap intervals in brackets: 2000 resamples of papers with replacement (seed 20261110); each paper keeps all its pairings. The difference row pairs papers that have both a real and a human-human pairing. Intervals reflect variation across papers only, not judge or extraction noise.
